source_title: Unix launches Zoom XB-U44 wireless speaker in India, priced at Rs 1,999 - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Consumer electronics and accessories brand UNIX has expanded its audio portfolio with the launch of the ZOOM XB-U44 wireless speaker in India. The new speaker comes with 16W audio output, Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity, RGB lighting and up to six hours of playback on a single charge, and is priced at Rs 1,999. The company said the ZOOM XB-U44 is aimed at consumers seeking an affordable portable speaker for everyday entertainment. The device is available in Black and White colour options through the official UNIX India website, e-commerce platforms including Amazon and Flipkart, as well as retail stores across the country.The UNIX ZOOM XB-U44 features two 57mm speaker drivers rated at 8W each, delivering a combined output of 16W. The speaker also supports True Wireless Stereo (TWS) functionality, allowing users to pair two compatible speakers together for a wider stereo sound experience. For wireless connectivity, the speaker is equipped with Bluetooth 5.4 and offers a connection range of up to 10 metres.The speaker is powered by a 1,500mAh battery, which UNIX claims can provide up to six hours of playback on a single charge. Charging is handled through a USB Type-C port with 5V input, and the battery can be fully recharged in approximately one to two hours.UNIX has adopted a low-profile rectangular design for the ZOOM XB-U44, allowing it to be placed comfortably on desks, shelves and side tables without occupying significant space. The company said the stable form factor makes it suitable for everyday use across different areas of the home. Adding a visual element to the listening experience, the speaker includes an integrated RGB light strip positioned along the front lower section, designed to complement music playback and entertainment sessions.The launch comes as UNIX celebrates 20 years in the consumer electronics industry. The company said it remains focused on developing products that combine practical functionality, contemporary design and everyday usability for Indian consumers. With the ZOOM XB-U44, UNIX is targeting the growing affordable audio segment, offering features such as TWS pairing, Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity, RGB lighting and Type-C charging at a sub-Rs 2,000 price point.Commenting on the launch, Sandeep Bafna of UNIX India said the company focused on combining functionality and aesthetics in the new product. "ZOOM is designed for consumers who want their everyday technology to be functional without compromising on how it looks. With its powerful audio, minimal and classy design, and accessible price point, we see it as a versatile speaker for young, modern consumers looking for both performance and value," Bafna said.You use AI every day.
